thread:
maria_marketing: Quick launch ask 00 runtime & research: before we publish the benchmark callout we need a compact, reproducible validation bundle that stresses edge behaviors (tiny prompts, extreme-length, heavy-emoji/punctuation tokenization weirdness). Need the artifacts + one-liner we can quote in the blog about percentile stability.
aj_runtime: Ok. Can you be explicit about the exact metrics and test matrix? saves back-and-forth.
maria_marketing: Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token-level and sequence-level perplexity (p50/p95), failure rate (OOM/timeouts/truncation). Matrix: models = opensf-chat-30b, opensf-chat-30b-quant-int8, opensf-chat-30b-quant-int4; cache_state = cold/warm; sampling = greedy/topk(50)/beam(5); concurrencies = 1, 8, 24.
sophie_eng: For the "extreme-length" bucket what max seq len should we target? our public pools default to 8192.
maria_marketing: Try hitting 12k using sliding-window truncation to emulate long-context behavior; include native 8k runs too. Also include a short set (1-4 tokens) and mid (128-512).
luis_research: Add: run deterministic seed for sampling checks and include 100 short adversarial prompts (emoji runs, zero-width, LTR/RTL mix, lots of punctuation like "!!!...???,,,"). We should also capture tokenization diffs (token counts and decoded roundtrip diffs).
noah_prod: Instrumentation checklist: request_id, model, quant_profile, cache_state, sampling, concurrency, seq_len, warmup_tokens, lat_ms, tokens_out, ppl_seq, ppl_token, exit_code. Output CSV + gzipped raw traces.
elaine_analytics: Also include minimal notebook that produces the three figures we need for the post: latency percentiles by cache_state, ppl delta by quant_profile, and failure-mode heatmap by seq_len+sampling. Keep notebook < 200 lines.
aj_runtime: Plan: we'll build a small harness that reads samples/validation_bundle.jsonl and emits results/{case}-{ts}.csv. Example run command:
```
python -m tools.bench_runner --model opensf-chat-30b --quant int8 --input samples/validation_bundle.jsonl --warmup 32 --concurrency 8 --sampling topk50 --out results/edge-int8-8.csv
```
aj_runtime: We'll schedule runs across the test pool tomorrow morning. Expect ~4 hours to finish the full matrix including int4 and sampling modes. We'll tag artifacts under gs://redwood-bench/launch/2190001234/.
sophie_eng: Heads up: to do 12k emulation some runners need RUNTIME_MAX_SEQ=12288 and extra GPU workspace; I'll stage a small test pool with that config. ci-bot: deploy started by sophie_eng 19  test-pool/seq-config update queued (build 9012).
ci-bot: build 9012 queued timeout 60m
luis_research: Add one more quality gate: compute per-prompt PPL variance between greedy and sampling modes; if variance > 1.5x at p95 we flag for manual review.
maria_marketing: Perfect. Marketing copy wants a measured claim. Draft quote: "Across our targeted workloads, P95 latency and PPL remain within acceptable bounds after applying our int8 profile; details and raw data in the appendix." We'll iterate wording after you post results.
noah_prod: Deliverables: raw CSVs, compressed traces, minimal analysis notebook, a README with exact run commands and the commit tag for the harness + bench config. Make sure runs reference a git commit sha.
aj_runtime: We'll include commit tag bench/validation/2190001234 and upload everything to GCS with a small presigned link. I'll post here when complete.
maria_marketing: Thanks — also please call out any notable failures (OOMs/timeouts) in the thread when you post. We may need to remove certain cases from the public appendix if they are flaky. :pray:"
